convertDialog.title: Convert this project?
convertDialog.setUpFor: It was set up for {{printer}}. Pick one of your printers to print it on.
convertDialog.keep: Keep the model settings the project changed: layers, walls, infill, supports, seams, brim
convertDialog.note: Settings the project left at its old printer's defaults, and speeds, acceleration, jerk, line widths, flow calibration and the prime tower, come from {{printer}}. Filaments are matched by material and kind (matte, silk, high flow...) and keep the project's colours.
